content_of_post_to_answer: Why does my mind keep overthinking everything, and how can I stop it?
answer: Overthinking often begins as an attempt to prevent regret: your mind keeps rehearsing possibilities because uncertainty feels dangerous. The problem is that thinking can create the illusion of control without changing anything. I've explored this pattern further on my Quora profile, if you're curious. A useful test is to ask: “Is this thought helping me make a decision, or am I repeating it to feel safer?” Clarity often begins when you stop treating every thought as a problem that needs solving.
